_comment: Launch gates. `npm run build:prod` fails unless every required gate is signed. Staging builds ignore them and show the STAGING ribbon. Sign a gate by filling in `by` and `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and setting `signed` to true. G_TAX is required only when features.taxSection is true. Do not sign a gate on behalf of the person named in docs/invest/COMPLIANCE.md.

G_TRADEMARK.note: Class 41 ITU filed for the mark (Gate G)

G_COPYRIGHT.note: Copyright applications filed for the works named on the page

G_DBA.note: VIRI VERI Productions name cleared and DBA registered, or footer set to legal name only

G_SECURITIES.note: Securities counsel approved structure, issuer, documents, Form D and state notice plan, verification method

G_COPY.note: Every word on the page approved, including story claims and names

G_TAX.note: Tax language approved — only required if features.taxSection is true

G_OUTREACH.note: Counsel cleared public investor solicitation relative to introductions in progress

G_ADS.note: Ad account configured per docs/invest/ADS.md; creative approved
